reason: A is the page I would rather maintain: no overflow at any width, at least 44px targets, a token-based type and spacing scale, and a keyboard-operable artifact that ties report rows to source lines, with every sample and the help text labelled as examples. B is lighter and well written, but it hides the file:line evidence at 768, 390 and 200% zoom, overflows at 320, has 25px nav targets, and presents unverifiable help text and an unlabelled sample as fact. If A's --ci mismatch reflected a real shipped flag set, or B labelled its sample and kept the read-at column on mobile, the gap would narrow.
